description: Insert an instance of a text variable at a text position: frame_id (a frame of the story, also on a parent page), name, index (default: end of the story). Returns instance_id, story_id, frame_id, index, result_text (what the variable shows there), story_length, overset. The instance counts as one character in the story.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

index.description: Character index in the story. Default: end.

name.description: Name of the text variable, exact.

name: insert_text_variable
title: Insert a text variable
